rebuilds.why: House notation: every option a temperature with the degree sign and a true minus sign ("-3" → "−3°C"). Same values, same tags; executions written for the three distractors, which had none.

stem.text: The temperature is 5°C. It falls by 8°C. What is the new temperature?

options.execution: The child loses the minus sign, or turns back at zero: 5 − 8 is −3, not 3. That gives 3°C instead of −3°C.
The child miscounts across zero and lands one step short. Eight steps down from 5 lands on −3, so −2°C is one step out.
The child takes the fall of 8°C as the new temperature and forgets to start from 5°C. Starting at 5°C, a fall of 8 gives −3°C.
